name: Cuddly Sheep 92
author: Pradeepsaranbishnoi
description: Gradient rounded gray radio button that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks:
Clicking it toggles it: box-shadow becomes 0.1em 0 0 #272626af inset,
			-0.1em 0 0 #272626 inset,
			0 0.1em 0 #847a62 inset,
			0 -0.1em 0 #0000007f,
			0 0.1em 0 #0000007f,
			0 -0.1em 0 #722257 inset,
			-0.1em -0.2em 0 #ffffff7f inset,
			0.2em 0 0 #ffffff7f inset, box-shadow becomes 0.1em 0 0 #272626af inset,
			-0.1em 0 0 #272626 inset,
			0 -0.1em 0 #722257 inset,
			0 0.1em 0 #847a62 inset,
			-0.1em 0 0 #847a62 inset,
			0 -0.1em 0 #0000001f,
			0 0.1em 0 #0000007f,
			-0.1em -0.1em 0 0.1em #ffffff7f inset, box-shadow becomes 0.1em 0 0 #272626af inset,
			-0.1em 0 0 #272626af inset,
			0 0.1em 0 #847a62 inset,
			0 -0.1em 0 #0000007f,
			0 0.1em 0 #0000007f,
			0 -0.1em 0 #722257 inset,
			-0.1em -0.2em 0 #ffffff7f inset. On focus, outline becomes transparent.
